  <p class="visually-hidden" id="rf-desc">Research overview as one isometric scene with three platforms. Platform A, physical dynamics, holds an iCVD chamber with a liquid-crystal film and an integrated energy and water network with wind turbines, solar panels, a plant, a water tower, pipes and buildings. Platform B, neural solvers, shows an input field passing up through operator layers and leaving as the predicted solution. Platform C, Model2Action, shows prediction tokens and action tokens driving a robot arm. Arrows read model from A to B, decide from B to C, and act from C back to A. A dashed arrow from C to B reads decision error trains the solver.</p>
